profile_facts.value: IFC’s 25 May 2023 release reports equity investments of $5 million by IFC and $16 million by IFC Emerging Asia Fund. These are components of the same financing, not separate rounds or additions to the company-reported total.

profile_facts.label: IFC proposal versus invested amount
profile_facts.value: The ESRS disclosed on 28 November 2022 describes a proposal of up to US$5 million for IFC’s own account and US$16 million through mobilization; it does not name the mobilized investor. These proposal terms are distinct from the later reported investments.
